facts.text: I have been trying to reduce my fashion waste.
I am interested in exploring sustainable fashion options.
I recently came across a fashion blogger on Instagram who shares outfit inspiration using second-hand clothing.
I didn't know about Depop and ThredUp before.
I will definitely check out Depop and ThredUp.
I have been thinking of trying to upcycle some old clothes.

I have been wanting to learn more about sustainable fabrics.
I will keep the environmental impact of different fabrics in mind when shopping for clothes in the future.
I am curious to learn more about the fashion blogger I mentioned earlier on Instagram.
I have been thinking about hosting a clothing swap with my friends.
I am excited to learn more about sustainable fashion and get inspiration for my own second-hand style.
